page.layout: One page of text, one column, with no marginal notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left. Catchword "entiam" at the lower right.

main_text.p: patienter adversa feramsquæ mihi inferri ab Ho-minibus permisisti, multo magis iniquas eorum calumnias qui haud contenti me Bello isto lædi maximè, id Mundo persuadere conantur me id primo excitasse, vel primam Causam dedisse excitandi.

Ea falsi-loquarum Linguarum confidentia est, ut Mc propemodum in Innocentiæ Meæ sufficionem adducant. Imo vel libens paterer (meo saltem silentio) tantum in Me reatum suscipere, modo vel sic Hostium malitiam placare licuisset, populumque Meum ab hoc Bello Calamitoso redimere, cum tu Domine cognoscas Innocentiam Meam hac in Re.
Tu viros sanguinum, & Dolofos inveniessquorum plurimi vix dimidiarunt dies suos, qui sibi Ipsis improbarum Machinationum fructus olim, & voluptatem spondebant.
Serva Domine famulum Tuum, quod adhuc fecisti, & dissipa Gentes quæ Bella volunt.
Exurge Domine, & exaltare in commotionibus hostium meorum, quæ jugiter crescunt, ascendunt semper: Ecce qui conceperunt dolorem, parturierunt Injustitiam, & pepererunt mendacium.
Tu scis, id maximè in hoc Bello agi, ut vel Personam Meam Interimant, vel vim faciant Judicio, vel me cogant Conscientiæ Meæ, & Veritati renunciare.
In hoc sum, ut (optione, illi Davidis contraria) optem potius illis Negando in Manus Hominum, crudeli utcunque Misericordia, quam in Tuas Manus incidere peccando adversus Conscientiam

page.notes: Small printed mark after "tandi." and a small asterisk in the left margin beside "Exurge": ornaments or reference marks with no text, not transcribed. "Domine ƒ exaltare": the mark between the words is ambiguous and was read as a comma. "ut Mc" may be "Me" (uncertain reading, not marked in the text). The final word "entiam" is printed right-aligned after "Consci-" and is treated as the catchword. The right margin shows the edge of the neighbouring page (show-through), which is not transcribed.
